maturity_grades.demonstration: Worked examples that show the shape of the layer; no breadth claim.
maturity_grades.partial: Real coverage across the area, with the remaining gaps tracked in the detail sources.
maturity_grades.broad: The recurring needs of the area carry records; the detail sources list the edge cases and open items.

areas.name: Founder processes
areas.summary: The operational corpus spans the founder journey from formation through exit, and every lifecycle phase carries processes. Chains link the core journeys, though some processes belong to no chain yet. The jurisdiction-scoped legal workflow layer holds demonstration workflows for two US scenarios only, and the shared-corpus import audit flags records that still lack outcomes or guidance.
known_gaps: Processes not yet linked into any chain
Jurisdiction-scoped workflows exist for two US-DE equity scenarios only
Imported shared-corpus records with missing outcomes, guidance, or placement flagged in the legacy audit

detail.tracks: canonical chain definitions and their ordered taskIds linking founder-visible journeys
jurisdiction-scoped workflow coverage per scenario, with maturity and stated limits
shared-corpus import audit: missing outcomes, guidance, vendor keys, and placement questions

areas.name: Vendor rankings
areas.summary: Live arenas cover the core startup and agent-infrastructure markets, each product judged on cited evidence. The roadmap lists more planned arenas than live ones, tiered by priority, so the planned tail is the dominant gap.
known_gaps: Planned arenas on the roadmap outnumber live ones
Thin-evidence products inside live arenas, surfaced by the depth aggregations rather than hidden

detail.tracks: every arena, tiered by priority, with live or planned status and candidate products

areas.name: Open modules
areas.summary: The cited calculations behind the corpus: cap table, rounds, vesting, deadlines, runway, unit economics, deferred revenue. A corpus-wide audit assigned every remaining candidate a verdict, so the open items are deliberate: standing SKIPs where no citable worked example exists, and DEFERs that wait on dated state rule cards.
known_gaps: State payroll, withholding completeness, and final-paycheck math deferred until dated state rule cards exist
VC fund back-office math open as a candidate pending a citable worked example

detail.tracks: the corpus-wide candidate table with BUILT, SKIP, and DEFER verdicts and their reasons

areas.name: Startup simulator
areas.summary: A deterministic synthetic company replayed over committed chains and judged rankings. It simulates only what the corpus carries, so a corpus gap is a simulator gap, and its multipliers and assumptions are disclosed in the catalog.
known_gaps: Simulates committed chains only; uncovered processes and jurisdictions stay unsimulated
Disclosed multipliers stand in for unmodeled company variance

detail.tracks: what the simulator runs and the assumptions and multipliers it discloses

areas.name: Legal rule cards
areas.summary: US startup law as dated rule cards: Delaware-focused with federal and several state layers, plus one EU data-protection card. The law map grades every domain and sub-area; most sub-areas are partial, with the missing recurring rules listed per sub-area.
known_gaps: Partial sub-areas, each listing the recurring rules still missing
Unmapped sub-areas, each listing the rules a startup hits first
Non-US law beyond the single EU data-protection card

detail.tracks: per-domain and per-sub-area maturity grades (mapped, partial, unmapped) with gaps listed

areas.name: Founder lore
areas.summary: Sourced founder heuristics recorded as claims across the schools and topics, with tensions between them recorded. The topic-by-school matrix has thin cells: several topics carry claims from only a few schools.
known_gaps: Thin topic-by-school cells where a school has no recorded claim on a topic
Claims limited to openly citable sources; uncitable advice stays out

detail.tracks: every claim's school and topic; the thin cells fall out of the matrix
the schools the matrix spans

areas.name: Open documents
areas.summary: Openly published legal documents linked by use case and jurisdiction, each verified live within the review window. The registry README records what was excluded and why, and names the use cases where no openly published canonical document exists.
known_gaps: No openly published canonical option plan or stock option grant exists; recorded as a gap, not a filler link
Jurisdiction spread is US-heavy, with pointed UK, EU, Singapore, and Canada records

detail.tracks: exclusions, dead-link corrections, and the use cases with no openly published document

areas.name: Open artifacts
areas.summary: The artifact registry and the typed field standards with their geo dimension; several country equivalents are recorded as unverified where the authority's pages are bot-walled, and absences are recorded where no equivalent exists.
known_gaps: IN authority pages bot-walled (CIN, PAN format)
FR/PT equivalents unverified for several fields

detail.tracks: the canonical business artifacts and their producers
the typed field standards, formats, and geo variants

areas.name: Rankings engine
areas.summary: The pipeline that produces the rankings, crawl through derive, with determinism gated by recompute-check and the golden suites. Its own gap is freshness: evidence ages between runs, and the staleness report tracks which arenas and products have drifted past their windows.
known_gaps: Evidence staleness between scheduled runs, tracked per arena and product
LLM stages run locally only; re-judging without new evidence is declined as wasted spend

detail.tracks: per-arena and per-product evidence age against the freshness windows

areas.name: Code layer
areas.summary: Loaders, scoring, calculation modules, and the simulator engine behind the open data. Every suite that gates it is listed in the test census; the user-facing surfaces it feeds are tested in the private site repo.
known_gaps: UI surfaces live and are tested in the private site repo
Calculation-module gaps are tracked under open-modules, not here

detail.tracks: the layer map: loaders, scoring, modules, simulator engine
every tracked test suite gating the code layer

areas.name: Jurisdictions
areas.summary: The registry lists only jurisdictions that sourced records touch, each scoped to the exact rules covered. Every entry is partial-example, and no jurisdiction is called covered because a few records exist.
known_gaps: Every listed jurisdiction is partial-example, scoped to the sourced rules in listed cards
Unlisted jurisdictions are unsupported by design; unknown means unsupported

detail.tracks: per-jurisdiction scope and coverage grade per layer

areas.name: Coverage rollup
areas.summary: This index plus the founder-journey files: domains.json maps the journey from formation through exit, including domains with no playbook yet, and coverage.json records which jurisdiction-scoped workflows exist. Most journey domains carry no jurisdiction-scoped playbook.
known_gaps: Most domains in domains.json carry no jurisdiction-scoped playbook
The index summarizes; an area that moves without an entry update shows up only at review

detail.tracks: the founder-journey domains, including those without playbooks
jurisdiction-scoped workflow coverage per scenario

areas.name: Schema contracts
areas.summary: Every committed record validates against a published contract in CI, and the generated schemas are drift-gated byte-identical to their zod sources. A fact that does not fit a schema changes the schema deliberately rather than landing in a free-text field.
known_gaps: Legacy process records remain accepted through the published legacy alternative until the shared-schema transition completes

detail.tracks: which contracts exist, which are generated, and how to regenerate them

areas.name: Policies
areas.summary: The review bar, the coverage maturity ladder, and the agent ground rules. The reviewed tier is defined and required for any coverage claim above demonstration; the committed records sit at the example and demonstration tiers.
known_gaps: No committed record claims the reviewed tier; demonstration is the current ceiling
Policy clarifications land case by case as ambiguities surface

detail.tracks: the maturity ladder and what each tier requires
what agents may do autonomously and what needs human authorization
